_README: Durable notes surfaced in the Fix queue tab of reports/site-report.html.
The report is regenerated in full every run, so notes MUST live here — anything typed into the HTML is lost on the next run.
Keys are scraper names exactly as they appear in scrapers/scraper-registry.js, plus the special key _global.
Each value: { note: string, priority: 'high'|'normal'|'low', added: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }.
A note on a scraper with no detected issues still shows up in the Fix queue, so this doubles as a to-do list.

_global.note: STOP before doing WordPress-{state} selector work. Measured 2026-08-05 with scripts/find-duplicate-library-urls.js: 355 domains are shared across two or more ACTIVE states, covering 1073 of the ~4069 configured library entries. The seed data was generated by guessing '{city}library.org' from the city name, so madisonlibrary.org is assigned to libraries in 11 states, greenvillelibrary.org in 10, franklinlibrary.org in 10. A domain can be the real site of at most one of them. Until the URLs are corrected, a scraper returning 0 events may simply be pointed at another state's library — and broadening extraction would ingest that other library's events under the wrong name and state. Fix URLs before selectors. General discipline: read SCRAPER-FIX-LOG.jsonl first, verify claims before acting, run `node -c` on every modified scraper, and append one line per logical fix to SCRAPER-FIX-LOG.jsonl.

WordPress-NC.note: 90% of entries (80 of 89) share a domain with another state — the worst in the family. Do NOT treat its 7 zero-event MISMATCHes as extraction bugs until each URL is verified. Pettigrew Regional Library was fixed 2026-08-05 (had pointed at a Michigan library).

WordPress-VT.note: 72% of entries (69 of 96) have a colliding domain. Selector normalization was considered and deliberately deferred: VT and CT use a narrower 3-selector list than their 6 siblings, but broadening it while most URLs are unverified would ingest other states' events rather than fix coverage. Verify URLs first.

WordPress-CT.note: 68% of entries (79 of 116) have a colliding domain. Same deferral as VT — the narrower selector list is real and worth fixing, but only after the URLs are trustworthy.

WordPress-TN.note: 67% of entries (54 of 81) have a colliding domain, including the Seymour TN->CT and Baxter TN->ME cases found by Step 3d on 2026-08-04. Highest raw bug count in the family (15). Treat as a seed-data problem first, not an extraction problem.

WordPress-AL.note: COVERAGE GAP: Hightower Memorial Library (York, AL) was removed 2026-08-05. Its configured URL yorklibrary.org serves Kilgore Memorial Library in York, Nebraska, and the Alabama library has no official website — only a Facebook page, which this scraper cannot read. If it ever gets a site, re-add it. Do not re-add a guessed domain.

WordPress-GA.note: Part of the known WordPress-{state} platform-heterogeneity problem: each library runs a different theme/plugin, so there is no generic patch — this needs per-site DOM work. Confirm the URL is the right institution before blaming extraction.
